description: Shows a short form inside the conversation where the person picks the country they work in, how many days of leave they have, when they want to be away, who is travelling, what they enjoy and their budget. Their plan then appears in the same card. Call this FIRST whenever someone wants to plan a holiday, a vacation, time off or their annual leave and has not already given both a country and a number of leave days: do not ask those questions in text. Pass along anything they did mention. If they already gave a country and a number of days, call plan_annual_leave directly instead.

country.description: Country the person works in, if they mentioned it: a 2-letter code or the English name.

days.description: Days of leave, if they mentioned a number.

name: start_planner

planner.description: What the form shown to the user starts with. The user's plan arrives later, in the same card.

days.description: Days of leave preselected in the form.

title: Open the time-off planner
